text:
maria_cs: Heads up — Kumo AI overloaded APAC demo. They need a short-term QPS increase + allowlist for demo IPs (203.0.113.0/28). Renewal touchpoint in ~8 weeks, theyre sensitive to demo success. Can ops/infra help?
sam_ops: Happy to help. Which APAC region do they want pinned?
ivan_net: They asked for tokyo (ap-northeast-1). Provided IPs: 203.0.113.4 and 203.0.113.5 — prefer those whitelisted.
maria_cs: Customer note: "demo spike ~450 rps sustained; request soft QPS=2800 during demo window, please."
sam_ops: Proposed config: soft=2800, hard=3800, autorevoke=48h, 24h notice before revoke. Need eng-infra signoff for region pin + proxy ACL.
ivan_net: Checklist for eng-infra: 1) add CIDR 203.0.113.0/28 to tenant allowlist 2) set tenant.kumo-ai soft qps=2800 hard=3800 3) schedule autorevoke @48h 4) smoke test via healthcheck from allowed IPs.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: change draft: 2025-06-15T09:00:00Z — status: pending-approval. Summary: allowlist 203.0.113.0/28, soft=2800, hard=3800, autorevoke=48h.
ashley_renewals: Flagging renewals team — demo outcome impacts renewal timing. Please add post-demo feedback and a success/failure note.
finance-bot: finance-bot: noted — will prepare estimated token-cost delta after demo window and send to maria_cs.
ivan_net: Test command to validate allowlist post-deploy:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Forwarded-For: 203.0.113.4" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/healthcheck
```
Expect 200.
sam_ops: Ill run the healthcheck after the change and paste results. Rollback triggers: sustained latency > 600ms OR errors > 3% -> revert and notify CS + customer.
maria_cs: Customer asked for 24h pre-revoke notice and a short cost summary. Also requested a one-paragraph confirmation email after changes. Can someone own the email?
ivan_net: Ill draft the confirmation and share here.
ashley_renewals: Ill add the post-demo note to the renewal playbook and tag account MQL in CRM.
sam_ops: ENGOPS-4952 created: "kumo-ai: ap-northeast-1 temp allowlist + qps bump" — linking infra and ops. https://redwood.internal/ops/ENGOPS-4952
maria_cs: Thanks — please post status updates in this thread and ping me if approvals slip. :thumbsup:
